title: hieracium furfurosum
intro: Hieracium furfurosum, commonly known as False Hawkweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can help to alleviate digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium furfurosum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium furfurosum, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
